text:
maya: post-deploy synth kicked off for release r-2026 (eu1). baseline p95=105ms
deploy-bot: [auto] synth-run start id=kv-prefill-eu1-7c1b compare=105ms timeout=6s
sam: seeing a p95 jump to ~900ms and a handful of 503s on the kv-prefill probe
kai: checking infra: two hosts showing GC pause ~1.7s and elevated retransmits around 09:02 UTC
tessa: canary at 20% in eu1, recommend pausing rollout and pinning until we confirm
maya: agree. routing override now: pin eu1 -> v1.2.3, reduce new-variant weight to 0%
sam: rollback-pin applied at 09:05. note: downstream prefix caches may still be cold, suggest waiting ~120s before re-eval
deploy-bot: rollout log appended: "pinned eu1 to v1.2.3 due to prefills + GC spikes. host rotation + warmup planned" ticket=INC-5510
obs-bot: synth snapshot pre-pin p95=900ms (09:03), post-pin p95=160ms (09:08), 5xx from 3.4% -> 0.5%
kai: logs from host-91:
```
2026-03-21T09:02:56Z host-91 gc_pause=1.72s prefix_fetch=512ms net_retrans=11
2026-03-21T09:02:57Z prefixcache miss key=rn-77 backend_fetch=498ms
```
maya: root cause looks like cold prefix cache aggravated by GC on a small subset of hosts. plan: 1) pin (done) 2) sequential drain & restart affected hosts 3) run a low-concurrency warmup hitting top prefixes for 7m
tessa: +1. sam, can you relax the smoke flapping detector for this rollout by +150s to avoid premature rollback noise?
sam: updated smoke policy for r-2026 at 09:09: prefill_grace=+150s
kai: rotating hosts now, one-by-one. warmup job started at 09:11 hitting top-200 prefixes at ~4 qps
obs-bot: post-warmup synth (09:18): p50=26ms p95=140ms 5xx=0.2% -> within thresholds
tessa: great. after kai confirms rotation complete, propose a targeted 5% canary for 15m then promote if metrics hold
kai: rotation completed 09:20, warmup hit-rate steady, prefix hit ratio improved
maya: thanks all. leaving thread open 30m. will post final promote note or further action. :white_check_mark:
